name: @effigent/runtime
description: Effigent runtime — wrap your Anthropic client to record every model call of an API agent into your Effigent workspace (and, later, apply the policies you approve).

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node18 --outfile=dist/index.js && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node18 --outfile=dist/index.cjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly && node check-bundle.mjs
